card.name: The word a before CYP substrate
card.fires_on: The word "a" right after "[drug] is" in drug-interaction sections, just before "CYP3A (4) substrate". It also fires on a few linking words before a drug class name, such as "with" before "a statin".

modes.label: Is a CYP substrate
modes.description: The article "a" after a drug name and "is", introducing that the drug is a CYP3A or CYP3A4 substrate.
modes.example: Elacestrant is<< a>> CYP3A4 substrate. Con

modes.label: Linking word before drug class
modes.description: A short linking word or word start just before a named drug class in an interaction list.
modes.example: are co-administered<< with>> a statin. Avoid
